record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> LORD<WH03068>, who shall abide<WH01481><WTH8799> in thy tabernacle<WH0168>? who shall dwell<WH07931><WTH8799> in thy holy<WH06944> hill<WH02022>? <RF>abide: Heb. sojourn<Rf>
He that walketh<WH01980><WTH8802> uprightly<WH08549>, and worketh<WH06466><WTH8802> righteousness<WH06664>, and speaketh<WH01696><WTH8802> the truth<WH0571> in his heart<WH03824>.

<FI> He that<Fi> backbiteth<WH07270><WTH8804> not with his tongue<WH03956>, nor doeth<WH06213><WTH8804> evil<WH07451> to his neighbour<WH07453>, nor taketh up<WH05375><WTH8804> a reproach<WH02781> against his neighbour<WH07138>. <RF>taketh...: or, receiveth, or, endureth<Rf>

In whose eyes<WH05869> a vile person<WH03988><WTH8737> is contemned<WH0959><WTH8737>; but he honoureth<WH03513><WTH8762> them that fear<WH03373> the LORD<WH03068>. <FI>He that<Fi> sweareth<WH07650><WTH8738> to <FI>his own<Fi> hurt<WH07489><WTH8687>, and changeth<WH04171><WTH8686> not.

<FI> He that<Fi> putteth not out<WH05414><WTH8804> his money<WH03701> to usury<WH05392>, nor taketh<WH03947><WTH8804> reward<WH07810> against the innocent<WH05355>. He that doeth<WH06213><WTH8802> these <FI>things<Fi> shall never<WH05769> be moved<WH04131><WTH8735>.<CM>
